_note: Weekly shows that aren't published as individual dated listings. scripts/recurring.mjs turns each into dated events for the next 90 days (Pacific time). When a venue publishes a specific show for the same night, the specific listing wins and the generic one is dropped. Weekdays: 0=Sun ... 6=Sat. skipDates: YYYY-MM-DD. Optional: nth (1 = first <weekday> of the month), end (omit if unknown), timeTBA (card shows 'Time TBA').
